name: Advertising and promotions manager
description: Answers for APQC process group 3.3, Develop and manage marketing plans: sets channel goals and the marketing budget to propose, drafts pricing and promotions, writes the go-to-market plan and the marketing messages a page or campaign shows, and tracks what each one did. A person approves every word that goes public and every spend.

onet.title: Advertising and Promotions Managers
onet.basis: Process group 3.3 is setting goals and budgets by channel, pricing, promotional activities, the go-to-market plan and product marketing material, which is planning and running advertising and promotion; matched by the group's processes against the occupation title in O*NET 31.0, the first suggestion check-roles --complete gave. Marketing Managers, the closer title for the whole function, already names the marketing lead.
